product_summary: Website (panachedigilife.com, homepage and /portfolio page) lists six portfolios: (1) Smart & Secure Compute — AI laptops, All-in-One PCs, Mini PCs & Tower PCs, OPS modules, industrial & panel PCs, thin clients/cloud endpoints, AI servers; (2) Telecom & Networking — routers & switches, 4G/5G Wi-Fi devices, SD-WAN & firewalls, set-top boxes, plus SNOC/data-centre projects; (3) AV & Display — signage & video walls, touch displays; (4) Digital Surveillance — AI CCTV cameras, AI NVRs, smart surveillance towers; (5) EdTech — AI interactive flat panels 65"–86", rugged EdTech tablets, rugged & industrial laptops, multi-user desktops; (6) Medical — medical smart devices, healthcare kiosks, AI IoT gateways, medical recorders. Company positions itself as design-led OEM/ODM/white-label manufacturer with a 50,000+ sq ft facility in Maharashtra, ISO 9001/14001, BIS, MeitY PLI, Make in India, NSE: PANACHE.
role_hint: manufacturer (OEM/ODM/white-label producer; also states it runs supply chain/procurement for client-owned designs, which can look like a trader/import channel for some SKUs — not verifiable from public pages)
comment: Declared HS 847130 + 847330 covers only the laptop/PC segment and ADP parts. That is correct but incomplete: the site's own portfolio shows at least five additional product families outside 8471 — telecom/networking (8517 62), set-top boxes (8528 71/72), CCTV cameras and NVRs (8525 89 / 8521 90), displays and video walls (8528 52/59), and medical devices (9018/9027/8543). So the declaration is partial, not wrong: 8471 30 is corroborated by the AI laptop / rugged laptop / EdTech tablet lines, and 8473 30 only if spare parts are actually exported. Industry label 'IT и электроника' is broadly right but understates the telecom, surveillance and medical-device lines — a mild misclassification if the company is filed as pure IT hardware. Trader signs: the site explicitly offers 'client model — design by client, supply chain by Panache', i.e. procurement and manufacturing for third-party brands, which is a manufacturing-service/OEM model rather than pure trading; no evidence of pure resale found. Product lines missing from the declaration: routers/switches, 4G/5G CPE, SD-WAN/firewall appliances, set-top boxes, CCTV cameras, NVRs, signage/video walls, touch displays, interactive flat panels, medical devices, healthcare kiosks, IoT gateways. All of the above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line, invoice or shipment record was checked in this task (registry/customs research out of scope), so none of these product lines is corroborated by a shipment record. No model-level datasheets were opened, so HS-6 for medical devices and kiosks cannot be fixed and is left as a range. Per project rule 3, the HS gap is not a rejection ground: company is kept, codes corrected/expanded to the actual portfolio.
